shortDescription: NetApp Cloud Manager CVO for GCP

options.name: backup_volumes_to_cbs
options.description: Automatically backup all volumes to cloud.

options.name: capacity_package_name
options.description: Capacity package name is required when selecting a capacity based license.

options.name: capacity_tier
options.description: Whether to enable data tiering for the first data aggregate.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector. You can find the ID from the Connector tab on U(https://cloudmanager.netapp.com).

options.name: data_encryption_type
options.description: Type of encryption to use for this working environment.

options.name: enable_compliance
options.description: Enable the Cloud Compliance service on the working environment.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: firewall_rule
options.description: Firewall name for a single node cluster.

options.name: gcp_encryption_parameters
options.description: The GCP encryption parameters.

options.name: gcp_labels
options.description: Optionally provide up to four key-value pairs with which to all GCP entities created by Cloud Manager.

options.name: gcp_service_account
options.description: The gcp_service_account email in order to enable tiering of cold data to Google Cloud Storage.

options.name: gcp_volume_size
options.description: GCP volume size.

options.name: gcp_volume_size_unit
options.description: GCP volume size unit.

options.name: gcp_volume_type
options.description: GCP volume type.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: The type of instance to use, which depends on the license type you choose. Explore ['custom-4-16384']. Standard ['n1-standard-8']. Premium ['n1-standard-32']. BYOL all instance types defined for PayGo. For more supported instance types, refer to Cloud Volumes ONTAP Release Notes.

options.name: is_ha
options.description: Indicate whether the working environment is an HA pair or not.

options.name: license_type
options.description: The type of license to use. For single node by Capacity ['capacity-paygo']. For single node by Node paygo ['gcp-cot-explore-paygo', 'gcp-cot-standard-paygo', 'gcp-cot-premium-paygo']. For single node by Node byol ['gcp-cot-premium-byol']. For HA by Capacity ['ha-capacity-paygo']. For HA by Node paygo ['gcp-ha-cot-explore-paygo', 'gcp-ha-cot-standard-paygo', 'gcp-ha-cot-premium-paygo']. For HA by Node byol ['gcp-cot-premium-byol'].

options.name: mediator_zone
options.description: The zone for mediator. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Manager CVO for GCP to manage.

options.name: network_project_id
options.description: The project id in GCP associated with the Subnet. If not provided, it is assumed that the Subnet is within the previously specified project id.

options.name: node1_zone
options.description: Zone for node 1. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: node2_zone
options.description: Zone for node 2. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: nss_account
options.description: The NetApp Support Site account ID to use with this Cloud Volumes ONTAP system. If the license type is BYOL and an NSS account isn't provided, Cloud Manager tries to use the first existing NSS account.

options.name: ontap_version
options.description: The required ONTAP version. Ignored if 'use_latest_version' is set to true.

options.name: platform_serial_number
options.description: The serial number for the system. Required when using 'gcp-cot-premium-byol'.

options.name: platform_serial_number_node1
options.description: For HA BYOL, the serial number for the first node. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: platform_serial_number_node2
options.description: For HA BYOL, the serial number for the second node. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: project_id
options.description: The ID of the GCP project.

options.name: provided_license
options.description: Using a NLF license file for BYOL deployment

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Cloud Manager CVO for GCP should exist or not.

options.name: subnet0_node_and_data_connectivity
options.description: Subnet path for nic1, required for node and data connectivity. If using shared VPC, network_project_id must be provided. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: subnet1_cluster_connectivity
options.description: Subnet path for nic2, required for cluster connectivity. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: subnet2_ha_connectivity
options.description: Subnet path for nic3, required for HA connectivity. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: subnet3_data_replication
options.description: Subnet path for nic4, required for HA connectivity. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: The name of the subnet for Cloud Volumes ONTAP.

options.name: subnet_path
options.description: Subnet path for a single node cluster.

options.name: svm_name
options.description: The name of the SVM.

options.name: svm_password
options.description: The admin password for Cloud Volumes ONTAP. It will be updated on each run.

options.name: tier_level
options.description: The tiering level when 'capacity_tier' is set to 'cloudStorage'.

options.name: update_svm_password
options.description: Indicates whether to update svm_password on the CVO. When set to true, the module is not idempotent, as we cannot read the current password.

options.name: upgrade_ontap_version
options.description: Indicates whether to upgrade ONTAP image on the CVO. If the current version already matches the desired version, no action is taken.

options.name: use_latest_version
options.description: Indicates whether to use the latest available ONTAP version.

options.name: vpc0_firewall_rule_name
options.description: Firewall rule name for vpc1. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc0_node_and_data_connectivity
options.description: VPC path for nic1, required for node and data connectivity. If using shared VPC, network_project_id must be provided. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc1_cluster_connectivity
options.description: VPC path for nic2, required for cluster connectivity. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc1_firewall_rule_name
options.description: Firewall rule name for vpc2. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc2_firewall_rule_name
options.description: Firewall rule name for vpc3. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc2_ha_connectivity
options.description: VPC path for nic3, required for HA connectivity. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc3_data_replication
options.description: VPC path for nic4, required for data replication. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc3_firewall_rule_name
options.description: Firewall rule name for vpc4. Option for HA pair only.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: The name of the VPC.

options.name: workspace_id
options.description: The ID of the Cloud Manager workspace where you want to deploy Cloud Volumes ONTAP. If not provided, Cloud Manager uses the first workspace. You can find the ID from the Workspace tab on [https://cloudmanager.netapp.com].

options.name: writing_speed_state
options.description: The write speed setting for Cloud Volumes ONTAP ['NORMAL','HIGH']. Default value is 'NORMAL' for non-HA GCP CVO This argument is not relevant for HA pairs.

options.name: zone
options.description: The zone of the region where the working environment will be created.
